'''2011 Belgium Regionals Chris Menzel LS Plead My Case To The Senate''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Chris Menzel]] at [[2011 Belgium Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Plead My Case To The Senate / Sanity And Compassion|Cor-L-pleadmycasetothesenate.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Supreme Chancellor Chris LS Senate on Speed
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.2]]
